description: A HUD participating housing counseling agency can help you understand housing choices and problems, including renting, buying a home or keeping your current home.
introduction: A HUD participating housing counseling agency can help you understand housing choices and problems, including renting, buying a home or keeping your current home.

who: Renters, homeowners and prospective buyers can seek housing counseling. The service is guidance; it does not itself establish eligibility for rental assistance or a mortgage.
sections.get: Counselors help people obtain, sustain and retain housing. Ask the agency which counseling topics it handles and whether it offers appointments by phone, online or in person.
sections.docs: Prepare the documents relevant to your question: a lease or mortgage statement, notices, a list of income and expenses, and any deadline. Ask the agency what it needs before sending records.
sections.apply: Use HUD’s housing counseling directory or call 800-569-4287 to find an agency.
sections.after: Explain any court, foreclosure or eviction deadline when booking. Ask for an agreed action list and clarify fees before accepting services. Counseling does not replace a court response or guarantee a lender will modify a loan.

faqs: Will HUD counseling pay my rent?
Counseling provides guidance. Ask the agency about separate assistance programs.
